about: Brand layout recipes: the new pattern helpers, when to use each, and the outline shape that feeds it. Every engine names a recipe by id (the LAYOUT: directive value). auto_themes lists the themes where the no-LLM engine picks a recipe by itself; on other themes a recipe is used only from a LAYOUT: line or an AI pick.

recipes.when: 3-6 parallel features or benefits, each a short label and one line
recipes.when_not: long descriptions, sub-bullets, or features with no clear icon
recipes.auto: 3-6 flat 'Label — description' items that each match a brand icon

recipes.when_not: a single number (use hero_number) or numbers that need a chart
recipes.auto: every item leads with a value (instead of the stat callout)

recipes.when: the one number a section hinges on
recipes.outline: - 40% — lower cost per token (vs. prior gen)
recipes.auto: a slide with a single value-led item

recipes.when: AMD vs. competitor metrics, each with a big value and why it matters
recipes.outline: | Metric | MI355X vs. B200 | Why it matters |  (or '- **Metric** — 1.3x — why')

recipes.when: specs down the side, 1-3 products across, AMD column highlighted
recipes.auto: a markdown table with an AMD product column header

recipes.when: AMD vs. competitor performance numbers per workload or model
recipes.when_not: non-numeric data, or more than 8 categories
recipes.outline: | Model | MI355X | B200 |  with numeric cells; optional 'Metric: Tokens/s (higher is better)', 'Date: …', 'Source: …' lines
recipes.auto: an all-numeric table with an AMD column on a performance-titled slide

recipes.when_not: numbers or long text in the cells
recipes.outline: | Capability | MI355X | H200 |  with cells ✓ / ✗ / partial; a row with only its first cell filled starts a group
recipes.auto: a markdown table whose cells are all check/partial/none marks

recipes.when: 3-7 dated milestones; mark the present one with (now)
recipes.when_not: milestones with several bullets each (use roadmap)
recipes.outline: **Q1 2025** then '- Label' and an optional second '- description' line; '**2025 (now)**' marks the current one
recipes.auto: 3-7 dated groups with at most two items each

recipes.when: a 3-4 stage process where each stage has a few points
recipes.outline: **Stage** then '- **Sub-head**' (optional) and bullets; a '> ' line becomes the closing line
recipes.auto: 3-4 headed groups on a process / workflow / pipeline slide

recipes.when: the back-matter list of endnotes behind 'See endnote' pointers
recipes.capacity: any; long lists flow into two columns

slide_lines.Source: …: source line under the content on these recipes
slide_lines.Endnote: PERF-01: 'See endnote PERF-01' pointer at the bottom right on these recipes
